main.summary: Provides append-oriented file-system staging operations for stream transfer sessions.

method.name: GetSessionPaths
method.summary: Resolve conventional paths for a stream transfer session.

method.name: CreateSession
method.summary: Create the staging artifacts for a new stream transfer session.
method.returns: Resolved session paths when creation succeeds.

method.name: LoadManifest
method.summary: Load the persisted stream transfer manifest for a session.

method.name: SaveManifest
method.summary: Persist the stream transfer manifest for a session.

method.name: ReadObjectPayload
method.summary: Read the serialized object payload stream for a session.

method.name: SaveObjectPayload
method.summary: Persist the serialized object payload for a session.
method.returns: True when the object payload is saved successfully.

method.name: WriteTail
method.summary: Append a payload range exactly at the current durable tail of the staged stream file.
method.param: Readable payload stream positioned at the first byte to append.
method.returns: Detailed outcome of the attempted append operation.

method.name: ReadRange
method.summary: Read a realized payload range from the staged append stream file.
method.returns: Readable stream covering the returned payload range.

method.name: DeleteSession
method.summary: Delete all staged artifacts for a stream transfer session.
method.returns: True when the staged session is deleted or no longer exists.
